snippet.title: You’ve Got a Package (Horror Game) TRAILER 2025
snippet.description:
You are Clark — a young and acclaimed writer whose debut novel became an international bestseller. Fame, money, recognition — he had it all. But now, a year has passed, and Clark hasn’t written a single word. A relentless creative block consumes him from the inside. Alone in his luxurious mansion, he struggles to put even a sentence on paper… and fails every time.

One sleepless night, the doorbell rings. On the porch, Clark finds a mysterious package with no sender. From that moment on, his life begins to spiral into a nightmare far darker than any writer’s block.
What’s inside the box? And more importantly… what happens once you open it?
